Answer: B
Reason: Although the provided images are CT scans rather than a chest X-ray, they demonstrate significant mediastinal widening and hematoma surrounding the thoracic aorta (specifically at the isthmus), which is the classic radiographic sign of blunt thoracic aortic injury. This finding corresponds to the description in option B regarding mediastinal widening consistent with peri-aortic hemorrhage.
